user.title: Thermostat Tile
user.description: Adds the Thermostat Tile card to your dashboards: a thermostat tile that shows mode, room temperature, preset and target temperature. After this, edit a dashboard, choose Add card and pick Thermostat Tile.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Thermostat Tile is already set up.

create_entry.default: Done. Reload this page once (press F5, pull down on a phone or tablet, or restart a kiosk app) so your browser loads the card. Then edit a dashboard, choose Add card and pick Thermostat Tile.

init.title: Thermostat Tile
init.description: The target temperature the tile's buttons set. Leave a field empty to keep the target as it is.

data_description.heat_temperature: Heat raises the target to this temperature when it is lower, for example 21.5.
data_description.eco_temperature: Eco sets this target before it switches on the eco preset, for example 16.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Like the tile's Heat button: heating on, eco off, and the target up to the heat temperature (Configure) when it is lower.

eco.name: Eco
eco.description: Like the tile's Eco button: heating on when it was off, the target to the eco temperature (Configure), then the eco preset.
